Definition: from G303 and G4098; to fall back, i.e. lie down, lean back:--lean, sit down (to meat).
BiblicalUsage: The word means to fall back, to lean back, to sit down at table: the disciple lying on Jesus' breast asks Him who it is — and when the hour was come, Jesus sat down, and the twelve apostles with Him. It appears eleven times, always at a meal or a leaning — the posture of those who eat together, and of the disciple who leans on Jesus.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for leaning back carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the table — the disciple on Jesus' breast, and the twelve sitting down with Him at the hour.
